correctness.rationale: Reconstructed dimension-six reduction: source handles nonnegative basic l-directions and all negative directions of support ≤5; only full-support v_p=(1^p,−1^(6−p)), p=3,4,5 new. For x1≤…≤x6, b=x/(e^x−1), d=x+b, U=Σbd/Σb. Directional derivative has positive weight combination R(j), minimum at j=1 by b′ and d monotonicities. Put G_x1(y)=b(y)d′(y)+b′(y)(d(y)−d(x1)). If G(x_(p+1))>0, the first p terms dominate last 6−p since p≥6−p and G initially decreasing before its zero. Otherwise last block nonpositive and min first p reduces to b(x1)d′(x1)+(p−1)G_x1(y)=P_(p−1,p−1)(x1,y)≥0 for p−1=2,3,4. Reviewed package exact formulas and finite stress program; independent high-range random checks of P_{k,k} show positivity for k≤4 and negative for k≥5, agreeing with reported threshold. Infinite proof rests on published auxiliary Lemmas A.1–A.2; the exact 19-page author-hosted primary PDF was located and materially read, including its Section 2 directional derivative reduction (pp. 3–6), Appendix Lemma A.1 (p. 7–8), Lemma A.2 (p. 9–11), the (4,4) proof and B lemmas. Explicit inequality P_{4,4}(x,y)≥0 for all positive x,y is VERIFIED in the source, not inferred from snippets. Supplementary finite tests do not replace that analytic lemma.
